data.response:
**Pick Rossi Idraulica.** It's cheaper once VAT is counted, and the warranty is double.

| | Rossi | TermoCasa |
|---|---|---|
| Total incl. VAT | **3,950 EUR** | 4,148 EUR (3,400 + 22%) |
| Warranty | 10 yr, needs yearly service | 5 yr |
| Can fit | in two weeks | next week |

Why Rossi: 198 EUR cheaper, old unit removal is explicitly included (TermoCasa doesn't say), it's the same Vaillant ecoTEC brand you already have, and Marta already services your boiler every November, so the yearly-service condition on the ten-year warranty costs you nothing extra. The only thing TermoCasa wins is one week of lead time.

One caveat: missing a yearly service voids Rossi's extended warranty, so keep the November appointment.

Full report at `vault/Projects/Research/2026-10-14-0457-boiler-quote-comparison.md`, also attached.
